## Pre-registered backtest grid

Under the [shared rules of round 1](https://github.com/Acusick1/odds/issues/821). Pooled across the six leagues: the Betfair job collects the exchange in each league.
- m (the exchange fair probability's rise over the lookback) ∈ {0.01, 0.015, 0.025} × lookback ∈ {180, 360} min × g (the gap still required at decision time) ∈ {0, 0.01}: 12 cells.
- Decision times are fixed at [120, 60]. `max_input_age_minutes` is 10 at the decision point and 60 at the lookback.
- The short-window version anchored to team news is a separate idea and family: [team-news latency](https://github.com/Acusick1/odds/issues/832).
